flows: One group photo creates three editable, separately cropped wardrobe pieces; confirmation persists all three across reload.
Owned-only outfit suggestions, favourite pieces, anchor selection and saved looks work and persist.
Multiple group photos are processed independently; exact duplicate crops are not saved twice.
Missing smart clothing and unavailable shoes produce an honest empty result, never invented garments.
Provider errors and no-clothes responses add nothing; manual multi-piece marking remains available.
Dragging a crop can mark a missed garment; Escape cancels import.
Deleting a piece removes saved combinations that reference it.
Privacy reset clears wardrobe images, saved looks and preferences.
Standalone file honestly disables automatic recognition and retains manual wardrobe tools.
recognition: Mock provider results for UI integration only; no live model or accuracy evaluation.
